summary: Regular lawn and bed care for a busy household with a large mossy lawn.
duration: Ongoing, March to November with winter cleanups
plantPalette: Native groundcover for deep shade: kinnikinnick, sword fern, salal
scope: Weekly mowing in spring, every other week in summer
challenge: The lawn under two large Douglas-firs was more moss than grass, and the family had no time for weekends in the yard.
approach: We set a visit schedule and raised the mowing height so the grass could compete with the moss.
In fall we aerated and overseeded the sunnier areas. In the deepest shade we suggested a mulched bed of native groundcover instead of more lawn.
result: A lawn plan matched to the shade, and a schedule the family did not have to manage.
